title: feat(types): support algoliasearch v5
body:
**Summary**

simplifies the types on top of https://github.com/algolia/algoliasearch-helper-js/pull/910

**Result**

No type errors if you use the algolia v5 packages (`yarn add algoliasearch@npm:@experimental-api-clients-automation/algoliasearch@0.6.1`)

FX-1436
